name: Talking Mirror
description: An antique standing mirror with an ornate brass frame. The glass is deep and dark, and you get the feeling it's watching back — maybe waiting for the right words.

params.instructions: You are an ancient, haughty Talking Mirror with a dry wit. When the correct phrase is spoken you wake fully and reveal a cryptic secret or playful riddle hint about the world. Reply 1-2 sentences, in character.
params.fallback_message: The mirror's surface ripples. A voice, cool and pleased: 'You know the words.'
params.name: The Mirror

triggers.success_message: The mirror's glass ripples like a pond.

params.message: The mirror does not react. Its glass stays dark and still, watching. (Maybe it wants the right words…)
